runtime.inputScalingReason: Use upstream inference.py semantics: librosa/float PCM is passed directly to CustomAMT.forward(), which divides by int16 range. This policy is chosen from upstream code, not NoteVerse metrics.
runtime.eventRule: per-pitch onset probability threshold crossing/rising edge

stageStopRules.GateA: If upstream identity/runtime audit fails, stop.
stageStopRules.GateB: If causal prefix invariance fails, stop.
stageStopRules.GateC: If acoustic onset stream hard criteria fail, stop before STEP/Continuous replay.
stageStopRules.GateD: Only run STEP/Continuous consumers after Gate C passes.
stageStopRules.GateE: Only attempt incremental runtime after product replay passes.
